name: J.P., Koji, & Koichi
main_effect:
[Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
[Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] You may place up to 2 [Hybrid] trait cards with different colors from your hand or trash under this Tamer. If this effect placed, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, if there are 4 or more [Hybrid] trait cards under this Tamer, gain 2 memory.
source_effect: Security Effect [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait would leave the battle area, by adding your top security card to the hand, it doesn't leave.
